description: Sub-agent status contract for Solo-Code-Harness — governs status transitions and resource allocation for spawned sub-agents.

governance_rules.lead_agent_responsibility: Read status, classify result, synthesize findings. Do NOT copy sub-agent output verbatim.
governance_rules.failure_recovery: On 'failed' or 'timed_out' — retry with reduced scope once. If retry fails, escalate to user.
governance_rules.context_isolation: Each sub-agent receives only the task-relevant context, not the full session.
